title: Review Level Pekerja
ringkas: Latihan campuran semua materi level pekerja
goals: mengulang ungkapan **perkenalan**, small talk, dan **permintaan sopan** di tempat kerja
mengerjakan **latihan campuran** dari seluruh materi Level Pekerja

lesson.text: Ini unit terakhir Level Pekerja / Formal. Kamu akan **mengulang semuanya**: bahasa untuk berkenalan, menulis email, menelepon, mengatur jadwal, rapat, laporan, presentasi, melayani pelanggan, memberi masukan, dan bepergian. Baca rangkuman, lalu kerjakan Latihan dan Kuis.

lesson.title: 1. Rangkuman situasi kerja
table: [[I work as ... in the ... department.]] / [[It's a pleasure to meet you.]]
[[Could you ...?]] / [[Would you mind ...ing?]] / [[I was wondering if ...]]
[[I am writing to ...]] / [[Please find attached ...]] / [[I look forward to hearing from you.]]
[[... speaking.]] / [[I'll put you through.]] / [[Can I take a message?]]
[[How about Tuesday at ten?]] / [[Could we reschedule for ...?]]
[[In my opinion, ...]] / [[Sorry to interrupt, but ...]] / [[To sum up, ...]]

[[I understand how frustrating that must be.]] / [[I apologise for the inconvenience.]]

[[I have a reservation under ...]] / [[What time is check-out?]]

lesson.title: 2. Tata bahasa yang sering dipakai
table: [[Could you tell me where the office is?]] (urutan biasa)
[[have/has + V3]]: hasil sekarang; [[for]] durasi, [[since]] titik waktu
[[The issue has been resolved.]] / [[It was agreed that ...]]

lesson.title: 3. Formal vs santai
table: [[Would you mind ...ing?]] / [[I was wondering if you could ...]]
[[Thank you very much. I appreciate it.]]
[[I look forward to seeing you. / Best regards,]]

lesson.title: Tiga prinsip komunikasi kerja
lesson.text: **1. Jelas**: sebut tujuan di awal. **2. Singkat**: satu pesan per kalimat. **3. Sopan**: pilih bentuk permintaan yang tepat dan ucapkan terima kasih. Terus berlatih agar semua ungkapan ini terasa natural.

lines.en: Good morning, Tom. How was your weekend?
lines.id: Selamat pagi, Tom. Bagaimana akhir pekanmu?

lines.en: Relaxing, thanks. Could you send me the sales report by noon? I'm preparing for the meeting.
lines.id: Menyenangkan, terima kasih. Bisakah kamu mengirim laporan penjualan sebelum tengah hari? Aku sedang bersiap untuk rapat.

lines.en: Of course. Sales rose by 10% compared with last month. I'll attach the chart to my email.
lines.id: Tentu. Penjualan naik 10% dibandingkan bulan lalu. Aku akan melampirkan grafiknya di emailku.

lines.en: Great. Thank you for your help.

items: Gunakan bahasa yang **jelas, singkat, dan sopan** dalam semua situasi kerja.
Email, telepon, dan jadwal: ungkapan standar membuat komunikasi cepat dan profesional.
Rapat, laporan, dan presentasi: struktur dan kata penghubung memandu pendengar.
Layanan pelanggan dan masukan: dengarkan, berempati, beri solusi.

read.text:
Subject: Invitation – Customer Service Training. Dear colleagues, we are pleased to invite you to a customer service training session on Thursday, 12 October, from 9.00 a.m. to 12.00 noon in Meeting Room A.
The trainer, Ms. Laura Chen, will cover three topics: handling complaints, writing professional emails, and speaking politely on the phone. Please bring your laptop and a notebook. Kindly confirm your attendance by Monday so that we can prepare enough materials. Best regards, HR Department

Bulan lalu, tim Dewi harus menyerahkan laporan dalam dua hari. Pada hari pertama, data masih belum lengkap, dan seorang rekan kunci sakit. Dewi mengadakan rapat singkat dan membagi tugas dengan jelas. Dia meminta setiap anggota mengirim pembaruan singkat di akhir hari.
Berkat rencana ini, mereka menemukan data yang hilang, menyelesaikan laporan tepat waktu, dan mengirimkannya kepada klien sebelum tenggat. Klien mengirim email terima kasih, dan manajer Dewi memuji tim dalam rapat mingguan.

read.text:
Last month, Dewi's team had to deliver a report within two days. On the first day, the data was still incomplete, and a key colleague was sick. Dewi called a short meeting and divided the tasks clearly. She asked each member to send a brief update at the end of the day.
Thanks to this plan, they found the missing data, finished the report on time, and sent it to the client before the deadline. The client sent a thank-you email, and Dewi's manager praised the team in the weekly meeting.

Tahun lalu, perusahaan kami pindah ke gedung baru. Sebelum pindah, staf telah bekerja di kantor yang sesak selama sepuluh tahun. Ketika para pengangkut membawa kotak-kotak, tim TI sedang memasang jaringan baru.
Sekarang semua orang sedang menyesuaikan diri. Kantor baru telah memperbaiki pekerjaan harian kami, dan karyawan mengatakan mereka merasa lebih nyaman. Bulan depan, perusahaan akan membuka kantin kecil. Jika staf menyukainya, perusahaan akan menambah gym juga.

qs.answer: The company will open a small canteen.
qs.exp: will + kata kerja dasar.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Perusahaan akan membuka kantin kecil."

read.text:
Last year, our company moved to a new building. Before the move, the staff had worked in a crowded office for ten years. While the movers were carrying the boxes, the IT team was installing the new network.
Now everyone is settling in. The new office has improved our daily work, and employees say that they feel more comfortable. Next month, the company will open a small canteen. If staff like it, the company will add a gym as well.
read.title: Review: The Office Move

read.text:
Last Monday, I started my new job at a logistics company. Before I joined, I had worked in sales for three years. On the first day, while my manager was showing me the office, I met most of the team.
Since then, I have been learning the company system, and I have already finished two training courses. At the moment, I'm preparing my first report. If I do well, my manager will give me a bigger project next month. I think I have made a good start.
